Monitoring Flink with Prometheus and Grafana

Monitoring the health of your Flink jobs helps to verify that your operations are running smoothly.

You can use any monitoring solution compatible with Prometheus to collect, store, visualize, and set up alerts based on metrics provided by IBM Operator for Apache Flink.

Grafana

You can use dashboards in the Grafana service to monitor your Flink instance for health and performance of your Flink jobs.

For examples about setting up monitoring with external tools such as Prometheus, see the tutorials page.
